Ingredients:

30 g of cake flour
20 g of cocoa powder
2 eggs
45 g of sugar
20 g of melted unsalted butter (or vegetable oil)
Favorite chocolate for glazing


Instructions:

1. Sift the flour and cocoa powder.
2. Whip the eggs with sugar until pale yellow.
3. Add the sifted dry ingredients in two stages.
4. Add the melted butter, mix thoroughly until homogeneous.
5. Pour the batter into a mini loaf pan lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake at 170°C (325°F) for 15 minutes.
7. Chop the chocolate, place it on the cake.
8. Bake at 160°C (300°F) for 10 minutes.
9. Cool for one hour.

2 яйца
